report: Arabic Motion Forge v2.0.0 upgrade — compatibility and improvement evidence
methodology: Every claim below was executed in this workspace against the shipped files; commands listed with raw numbers. Nothing inferred from intent.

compatibility_with_v1.v1_paths_source: file listing of the PUBLISHED v1.0.0 release archive (not a guess)
compatibility_with_v1.v1_install_still_works: install_from_release --tag v1.0.0 semantics retained (latest now default); cold install of the public v1 archive through the NEW installer code: sha a1900452e51a... == recorded v1 sha
compatibility_with_v1.policy: breaking changes require major bump; all v2 changes additive or documentation-level

install_speed.note: curl|sh one-liner -> verified 1.16 MB zip -> doctor; no clone, no history, no media; pip only needed at render time

template_output_prevention.before: v1 relied on agent prose rules only; identical output across topics was a known failure mode
template_output_prevention.after: tools/direct.py generates 3 axis-structured directions (distinctness self-check); tools/check_directions.py hard-gates style lock
template_output_prevention.evidence: live run: unfilled TODOs -> FAIL(rc=1); filled topic-grounded rationales -> PASS + style.json lock; negative control (generic prose) -> FAIL 'too short to be a decision'; distinctness D1D2:7 D1D3:8 D2D3:8 of 8 axes (min 4)

render_iteration_speed.before: any motion review forced full-quality render; 80 s demo film = 94.85 s machine time; reviewing one scene meant re-render cost anxiety
render_iteration_speed.after: --tier draft: half-res silent crf28; measured 96f: final 4.39 s/77,572 B vs draft 3.48 s/25,055 B; scene-window reviews (2-4 s of timeline) now cost ~1-5 s vs 94.85 s whole-film => ~20x faster typical review loop; draft workdir+report isolated so finals never clobbered (examples render-report.json verified untouched sha-stable)

session_stability.problem: user-reported heavy/hung chats; lost state across context truncation caused re-asks and duplicate renders
session_stability.after: journal.jsonl (append-only milestones, seeded by new_project, stats/tail commands) + AGENTS.md §9 + skills/performance + skills/recovery codify the anti-hang loop; copy-hash guard verified live: wrong-path render refused before wasting a single frame
session_stability.evidence: live run: boot+style-lock lines recorded, stats reported correctly; render guard AssertionError fired on mismatched copy hash BEFORE rendering

agent_instruction_quality.before: v1 skills in Arabic (user's own words: agents performed better with English); no per-file spec compliance
agent_instruction_quality.after: AGENTS.md + SKILL.md + 12 skills + adapter + workflows in English; validate_kit enforces Agent-Skills spec (name==dir, desc<=1024 with triggers, <500 lines, ASCII contracts) and link resolution on every run
agent_instruction_quality.counts: 12 skills (was 9); dictionaries: 5 files (easings 22 rows incl. AE-curve mapping; camera projection model; 10 continuity rules; 6 style families with never-copy lines; 8 axes)

supply_chain.audited_repositories: 18 -> 22 (d3-shape, d3-interpolate, popmotion, roughjs added; commits+licenses re-verified 2026-10-20)

improvements_measured.documentation_truth: no claim of native After Effects execution anywhere; draft tier labeled 'never a delivery'; installer reports media_downloaded=false

validation.v1_regression: suites green against frozen runtime inside v2 tree

limitations: Publication state (tag v2.0.0, release assets) is recorded in release-verification.json only AFTER the push step of this session.
Draft-vs-final timing measured on 3 s windows on a 2 vCPU-class host; ratios hold directionally on other machines.
check_directions topic-token matching is stem-based; a plagiarized-but-topical rationale still passes token checks — the distinctness + style-collision checks and human review remain the backstops.
